0.long_answer: Phytophotodermatitis triggers a phototoxic reaction in the skin, often leading to overproduction of melanin, which manifests as hyperpigmentation. Whitening creams are used in such cases to reduce this excess pigment by lowering the melanin concentration in the skin. Thus, the application of the cream helps return the skin to a more uniform tone by reducing the overabundance of melanin produced during the inflammatory process.
